Following our guidance, you added a yearly price to your product, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show on your checkout page.
Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the After purchase redirect option and saved it, and a test purchase took you straight to your thank-you page.
A second price is added from the product's Pricing section using Add price.
The redirect is set in the product's Pages settings, under After purchase redirect.
There is a tax setting for adding GST to your prices. This is not yet resolved.
Add your privacy policy link to your checkout footer. You mentioned that you planned to do this during the week of our call.
